allow: PowerShell($p = \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8013 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).OwningProcess; if \($p\) { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force; Write-Output "servidor de teste parado \(PID $p\)" } else { Write-Output "porta 8013 livre" })

PowerShell($p = \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8013 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).OwningProcess; if \($p\) { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force; Write-Output "servidor de teste encerrado \(PID $p\)" } else { Write-Output "porta 8013 ja livre" })

PowerShell(foreach \($port in 8013,8014\) { $p = \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).OwningProcess; if \($p\) { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force; Write-Output "porta $port liberada \(PID $p\)" } })
